approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the ACME Bonsai Customer Service Manager team (Poppy)

approve_refund_small.notes: Refunds ≤ $500: Poppy approval. Clear rationale + customer context required.

approve_replacement_tree.notes: Replacement tree for verified quality issue: Poppy approval. Coordinate with Tally for inventory.

approve_store_credit_or_waiver.notes: Store credit or fee waiver ≤ $200: Poppy approval.

approve_rental_damage_dispute_large.notes: Rental damage disputes > $300: Jane approval. Coordinated with Cedar (COO) for damage assessment.

approve_major_account_save.notes: Concessions to retain major account (wholesale > $10K/year or subscription > $1K/month) require Jane approval.

approve_subscription_cancellation_save.notes: Subscription cancellation due to repeated quality failures requires Poppy + Jane review of save options.

approve_legal_response.notes: Any response to customer using legal language requires Jane approval. Route to legal if engaged.

approve_pattern_issue_response.notes: Pattern of same issue ≥ 3 customers: Jane approves response strategy + corrective action. Operating team owner identified.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop on outbound replies can be activated immediately by Poppy or Jane.
